cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Give It Up
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender something they value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved a new fridge for us. Your signed guitar may finance it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I keep the guitar? I queued all night for that signature.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your dedication is recognized. I authorize a price that respects every cold hour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sell the case. The guitar stays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may keep the case as a memorial to that night. I'll photograph the guitar for sale; we can remember the cold while choosing an ice maker.

reason: Make A rule on which sentimental token may remain, using B separable-case compromise to continue persuasion toward surrendering the valued guitar.
